crossRefs.note: Isaac sowed in that land, and reaped in the same year one hundred times what he planted. Yahweh blessed him.

crossRefs.note: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass…
